patch_description:
This version keeps the input-aware repair-and-augment framework, but replaces the previous deletion heuristic with an exact obstruction-incidence score.

For every currently blocked missing edge `x-y` having exactly one length-three path `x-a-b-y`, the algorithm credits all three edges of that path: `x-a`, `a-b`, and `b-y`. Deleting any one of these edges unlocks `x-y`, so destructive moves are selected from edges that participate in many unique obstructions rather than only treating the middle edge of a path as useful.

The search uses several source-derived repairs, plus a small number of source-biased neutral completions from an empty edit state. All constructions remain guided by the supplied matrix through edge-retention orders and tie-breaking preferences. Each candidate is greedily saturated using a future-loss score, then archive-based obstruction-targeted ruin/refill moves search for improvements. Every addition is guarded by the C4 invariant and final validation is explicit.
